missionPremise: P-153 implemented the polygon-only reversal of Ruling B (operator 2026-09-11, _decisions/2026-09-11_ruling_b_reversed_polygon_only.md; CANON-PREAMBLE 'ENVELOPE DRAWN, FIGURE REFUSED'): the draw block draws the modelled buildable envelope from the same place/buildable-envelope derivation the map and export routes run, wherever a district and a setback table exist, while the buildable-AREA figure stays refused. The map half of P-339 shipped (hauska-map #422). The MCP half did not: tryComposeEnvelopeModelForDraw returned null for three DIFFERENT things (modelled, declined, unreached), so the caller could not tell a real decline from an attempt that never got there, and the refused overlay fell back to the bake's stored atom_path_pending. In @empressaio/atom-contract/display's own VOCABULARY that token means 'have not been ruled or baked for this jurisdiction yet; no distance or polygon exists to report', and envelopeHuman renders it 'Withheld, setbacks unruled' -- the exact claim the named payloads falsify, since they carry ruled tables (e.g. 48453:367134 front 25 / side 5 / rear 10 / corner 15).
completionPredicate: A stranger can evaluate this without me: in the merged code, the envelope reason on the MCP draw block is decided by the drawing route's own outcome; atom_path_pending is reachable only when no property atom chain exists at all; a drawn polygon is served state 'present' with basis modelled-figure-withheld and no reason; the pinned null-contract tests in parcelDrawEnvelopeModel.test.ts are re-pointed (not deleted) and pass; and the pre-registered falsifiers pass in BOTH directions (chain present -> not atom_path_pending; chain absent -> atom_path_pending). One PR from base 2e7ca7c4; no merge, no deploy.
scopeBasis: The dispatch names exactly four sites, and all four sit on the single decision path that produces the refused overlay's reason: parcelDrawEnvelopeModel.ts:89 (the collapsed result), parcelDrawFromReads.ts:69/:77 (the bake's token outranking the attempt), parcelDrawStub.ts:545 (the overlay's own invented default), propertyExplorer.ts:355-362 (the gate deciding which reason reaches the overlay). Widening beyond that would be the same defect in a new place. Deliberately EXCLUDED, and why: (a) authoritativeSetbackSource.ts is P-340's file and the dispatch says P-340 runs in parallel and may touch it; the dispatch's own leave_behind calls the unresolved-setbacks step 'the P-340 resolver gap seen from the MCP side', so this lane NAMES that step and does not fix it; (b) nodeFacetBakeTier1.ts / nodeFacetBakeTier2.ts still stamp declineReason atom_path_pending in the bake -- that is the anti-zombie marker's home and is correct there, because the bake genuinely stops authoring product envelope confidence; (c) hauska-map's stripCortexEnvelopeProductTruth / honestAtomPendingResponse are dispatch point 4's 'name them as out of scope'; (d) artifacts/smartsite-mcp needs no change: it is the display layer (envelopeHuman maps the token to its sentence) and it re-derives nothing.

whatTheWritePathSaysBeforeThisChange: Pre-change decision table, read off the code at base 2e7ca7c4. (1) propertyExplorer.ts: `envelopeModelled = atomPathPending(snapshot.envelopeBriefRefusal) && bakedZoningCode ? await tryComposeEnvelopeModelForDraw(...) : null`. (2) tryComposeEnvelopeModelForDraw returned `null` for a successful model, for a genuine derivation decline, AND for an attempt that stopped at the zoning guard, the query-point guard, the parcel-ring fetch, the identity guard, the setback resolver, the road fetch or the edge labeller, or threw. (3) parcelDrawFromReads.ts passed `envelopeRefusalReason: envelopeReason(args.envelopeBriefRefusal)` -- the BAKE's stored token -- regardless of what the attempt did. (4) parcelDrawStub.ts's envelopeOverlay emitted `reason: envelopeRefusalReason ?? "atom_path_pending"` for every refused envelope. Net effect: for an atom-pending parcel the bake's marker always outranked the attempt, and where the reason was absent the stub invented the same marker. There is no writer and no release rule in this lane; the only thing that changes is which string a read-only serving path composes.
theReleaseRuleAsWritten: Not applicable: this lane has no writer, no release rule, and no publish path. It changes a read-only composition on the get_smart_site draw block. Stated explicitly, never omitted, so an absent field cannot be mistaken for an inapplicable one.
preRegisteredPrediction: Written before the change and falsifiable per parcel. (P1) On each of 48453:367134, 48453:239852, 48309:103015, 48453:445501, 48055:27929, 48209:145880 the envelope overlay's reason stops being atom_path_pending and becomes the step the route actually stopped at. (P2) If that step is setbacks-unresolved with the chain PRESENT, the reason served is 'setbacks-unresolved' (a raw step name, not a VOCABULARY row) and it is NOT atom_path_pending. (P3) A parcel with no atom chain at all still reads atom_path_pending -- the token keeps its one true meaning. (P4) A parcel whose route draws serves state 'present' with no reason and basis modelled-figure-withheld. (P5) A real derivation refusal serves the route's own wireStatus verbatim (no-buildable-area and geometry-validation-failed stay distinct; P60b's split is not flattened). I also pre-register the honest possibility that P1 lands on setbacks-unresolved rather than on a drawn polygon for some of the six, because the resolver gap is P-340's and the dispatch accepts 'the route's own decline reason' as a pass.
falsifiersPreRegistered: F1 (both directions, the core claim): chain PRESENT at the setbacks step -> reason is NOT atom_path_pending; the SAME step with chain ABSENT -> reason IS atom_path_pending.
F2 (no-district): an atom-pending parcel with no baked district -> reason is no-zoning-stamp, never atom_path_pending, and the attempt costs no I/O.
F3 (fail-closed identity): the point-seeded attempt must never draw a stranger's envelope -- the parcel-identity guard reports parcel-identity-mismatch.
F4 (P60b not flattened): derivation-not-drawn carries the route's own declinedBy verbatim, and a null declinedBy lands on geometry-validation-failed, never on a withhold token.
F5 (the stub cannot invent): envelopeRefusalReason becomes a required non-null string at the stub boundary, so there is no `??` left anywhere that can mint atom_path_pending.
F6 (the drawn case is unchanged): the modelled arm still draws state 'present' with basis modelled-figure-withheld and carries no reason.

whatIsReadAndLeftForTheSeat: Left for the seat: (1) the deployed MCP text rows. The customer predicate is the P-254 MCP rows on the customer-leg probe, and the MCP leg needs the operator's sign-in, which the dispatch reserves for the seat after deploy -- this lane cannot run it and does not pretend to. (2) The per-parcel failing step on the six named parcels. The instrument is now ON THE WIRE -- every refusal's reason is the step name -- so the seat's next probe reads it per parcel without a separate harness. (3) P-340's resolver gap: if the step is setbacks-unresolved with the chain present, making those parcels actually DRAW is P-340's work, not this lane's, and this lane's own falsifier F1 asserts only the honesty of the wording.
adversarialNotesOnThisDesign: THE ONE PLACE THE DISPATCH'S TWO CONSTRAINTS CANNOT BOTH BE MET VERBATIM, and it is disclosed in the code, not hidden: 'no new vocabulary token' cannot be honoured together with 'atom_path_pending is reachable only when no property atom chain exists' for a chain-PRESENT slope where the resolver returns nothing. @empressaio/atom-contract/display has exactly TWO humanised envelope-refusal rows -- atom_path_pending and no-zoning-stamp (verified by reading the installed dist/display/wire.js: envelopeHuman maps only those two and returns every other reason unchanged; the VOCABULARY array holds 36 `token:` rows). So 'setbacks-unresolved' and the other step names travel as RAW reason values, exactly as no-buildable-area and geometry-validation-failed already do. The alternative -- reusing atom_path_pending there -- is the defect itself, and minting a new VOCABULARY row is the new-token prohibition. Raw truth over polished falsehood; the customer reads a step name where they used to read a claim that was false.

The step set now includes derivation-threw, which the dispatch's list of candidate null sites does not name. This is deliberate: the old catch mapped EVERY throw to null, and mapping a throw to parcel-ring-unavailable would be a false step claim of exactly the kind this lane removes. A mutable stageAtThrow reports a throw at the stage it happened in where that stage has a name (the ring fetch, the edge labeller) and as derivation-threw where it does not.

Inert value, disclosed: when the outcome is modelled the assembler passes the string 'modelled-figure-withheld' as envelopeRefusalReason, because the stub's input is now required. A present overlay returns before reading it, so it can never reach the wire; it is chosen over a stale bake token so that if a future edit ever flips that precedence the value served would still be TRUE for a modelled envelope.

A residual inconsistency this lane does NOT fix, named so it is a decision and not an oversight: composeSmartSiteStub (depth 'stub') derives its envelope RAIL from the bake via envelopeDisposition(root.envelope, envelopeBriefRefusal), independently of the draw-block outcome. It carries a rail state, never a reason sentence, so it cannot produce the reported false wording -- but the stub rail can still read 'refused' while the draw block draws. That is the P-249/P-261 family (a figure/state on a surface without a verified envelope atom), not this row.

What could bypass this fix, answered now so the close can be held to it: (a) a CACHED draw-block response -- the MCP composes get_smart_site from upstream api-server verbatim and re-derives nothing (tool-honesty.ts:305-309), so a cached old payload keeps the old sentence until the cache turns over; (b) the stub-depth rail above; (c) any other reader of the bake's declineReason that humanises it through envelopeHuman -- grep finds none in a serving path, and 'unruled' appears in no source string this repository composes, only in tests and comments.
